records.text: In Turek's book account read by Owens, an unnamed surgeon announced that Charlie Kirk was dead about 30 minutes after Turek's group arrived. The surgeon's identity is unresolved.
records.speaker: Hospital surgeon (Ep 400 book account; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: About 30 minutes after our arrival, the surgeon from the OR steps into the hallway where we're all standing, his expressions like stone, he sternly announces he's dead.

conveyance.original_source: Unnamed surgeon quoted in Frank Turek's The War on Reality, read by Owens
